scope: Factual species notes for original stylized character generation. External photographs are not production assets or generation-reference inputs.

designation.name_ja: 高知県指定天然記念物
designation.note: Do not relabel this as a nationally designated Natural Monument. National endangered-species status is a different framework.

recognition_features: Chestnut-brown crown with a dark central stripe.
Cream-yellow eyebrow above a bold dark eye stripe.
Pale cream throat, chest and flanks; red central lower belly and vent.
Green back and shoulder feathers; cobalt-blue rump and short tail tips.
Very short dark tail; compact ground-bird body and relatively long sturdy legs.
fairy_pitta.english_generation_spec: An adult Fairy pitta (Pitta nympha), compact and round with a very short tail and two sturdy pale legs. Chestnut crown with a subtle central dark stripe, cream eyebrow and dark eye mask, cream throat and chest, emerald-green back and shoulders, cobalt-blue wing/rump accents, and a clear red central lower belly. Keep the red below the cream chest. Use a short pointed bill and a tiny dark tail tipped blue. Simplify details in the existing warm watercolor character style, preserving these identifying color regions.
avoid: Generic all-blue songbird or a parrot beak.
Red throat or an entirely red breast.
Treating eight colors as eight equal rainbow stripes.

onagadori.name_ja: オナガドリ（土佐のオナガドリ）
onagadori.scientific_group: Domestic chicken breed, Gallus gallus domesticus

designation.name_ja: 国指定特別天然記念物 土佐のオナガドリ

onagadori.visually_checked_choice: White variety: the official Nankoku City symbol photograph shows an all-white adult male with multiple long trailing white tail feathers.
onagadori.english_generation_spec_white: An adult male white-variety Japanese Onagadori rooster. A compact white-feathered body, small upright red single comb, red wattles, small pale earlobe, pale beak and two pale chicken legs. Its defining tail is a flowing group of several extraordinarily long, slender white feathers, separate strands with feather-like ends, trailing gracefully behind the body. Keep the whole tail visible. Match the existing warm watercolor animal-character style. It must remain recognizable as a rooster rather than a peacock or mythical phoenix.
onagadori.english_generation_spec_shirafuji_altern: If selecting the Shirafuji variety instead, preserve its white/silver head and neck with contrasting black plumage and a green-black sheen. Do not call an entirely white bird Shirafuji. Use the same unmistakable multiple long tail feathers, red comb and red wattles.
avoid: Peacock eye-spots or a fan-shaped tail.
One broad ribbon replacing the separate long feathers.
Fox-like fluffy tail, a dragon tail, a short ordinary rooster tail, or cropped tail ends.
Calling the unrelated wild Onaga magpie an Onagadori.
onagadori.registration_note: Register body height/foot anchor separately from the full tail-inclusive footprint. Do not shrink the body to normalize a long-tail bounding box.

other_character_identity_notes.siamese_cat: Cream body, dark color-point mask/ears/paws/tail, blue eyes; do not substitute tabby stripes or a raccoon mask.
other_character_identity_notes.red_panda: Rust-red body, cream face markings and ear edges, dark legs, bushy ringed tail; do not substitute a giant panda or raccoon.
other_character_identity_notes.meerkat: Upright slender tan body, dark eye patches, small rounded ears, pointed muzzle, thin tapering tail; avoid a ringed raccoon tail.
other_character_identity_notes.kangaroo: Long ears, short forelimbs, powerful long hind legs with large feet and a thick tapering supporting tail; no extra joey unless requested.
other_character_identity_notes.hedgehog: Rounded short-spine coat, small ears, pointed snout and small bare feet; keep face/belly unspined and avoid porcupine-length quills.
